title: PartOnHand
description: One item the user has lying around, named or photographed. Saved for later repairs and checked in order: exact mpn, same spec within tolerance, researched substitute, print, buy. Protective parts are judged on their protective role or the answer is no (S2).

kind.description: Free text class, e.g. 'fuse', 'phone charger', 'JST-XH 2-pin lead', 'speaker wire'.

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number if known or read by OCR.

spec.description: Extracted ratings as typed values. Units in key names: volts, amps, ohms, watts, awg, length_mm, connector_family, pins.

protective.description: Only for fuse, polyfuse, TVS, BMS, thermal cut-off. Any null here means 'cannot confirm' and forces verdict no.

datasheet_extract.description: Ratings table text we pre-extracted, so a long datasheet's tables reach Grain's design turn intact.

match.description: Result of checking this item against a part in the current plan.

matched_part_ref.description: BOM ref it was checked against.

order.description: Which rung of the ladder matched. print and buy are not matches of an on-hand item.

basis.description: simulation_check means Grain's simulation check passed on a project copy with the swap; a limited check, never 'verified' (I5).

safety_notes.description: Always includes the polarity rule when the item is a supply (S1).
